title: Why Did He Laugh?
text: When we headed toward Riyute Village, sure enough, they were disposing of the monsters’ carcasses washed ashore by the waves. The villagers seemed to be in the process of gathering the carcasses in one spot.
“Kou said he wanted some for dinner, didn’t he? Maybe I should ask for a share…”

Father shifted his gaze to the chimera’s carcass. As expected, compared to when I had collected the materials, various parts had been stripped away, and it was in tatters. Rin and Itsuki must have taken the head.
“It’s pretty battered, but was that the Wave boss?”
“That’s right.”
“They did bring the head back, after all. But… it looks like the villagers are having trouble disposing of it.”
Father got off the wagon and went to talk to them. He seemed to be negotiating something with the villagers. Soon, he beckoned me over.
“They said they’re having trouble disposing of it, so let’s take it. Motoyasu, would you mind helping me cut it up?”
“Understood.”

Together with my Father, we swiftly cut up the chimera’s carcass with a series of sharp, clean cuts. Well, my spear is so sharp that it can easily cut through even bones. If anything’s unnecessary, we can just have my spear or my Father’s shield absorb it. In a way, it’s like a trash can from another dimension.
“Motoyasu, we’re going to give some of this to the villagers, so make sure to clean the bones properly.”
“Got it.”

So, Father put the chimera’s entrails into his shield to dispose of them, leaving behind clean meat. He absorbed part of it into his shield and turned his attention to the rest. But he looked as if he were wondering, “What should I do with the remaining parts?”
“I wonder if this will serve as food for the time being? It also looks like it would make good feed for the new Filolials we bought.”
“Oh… but the chimera’s meat looks pretty tough.”
“I’ve been processing meat like that all along, so it shouldn’t be a problem.”

That’s true. Monster meat varies depending on the species, but a lot of it is tough. It’ll be interesting to see how Father handles this meat, which looks like it might have a gamey smell at first glance. After all, “chimera” is written as “合成獣” (synthetic beast)—is it even safe to eat? …Since there’s such a thing as “mixed ground meat,” it might not necessarily be off-limits.
“Oh, Motoyasu-kun, you broke the fence at the village ranch, didn’t you? You really should go apologize, just to be safe.”
“Then I’ll go by myself.”

Even though it was to protect Filolial-sama and the others, the fact remains that I caused property damage. No matter the reason, I have to apologize. So I rode Yuki-chan over to the village ranch to offer my apologies.
“I’ve come to apologize for what happened yesterday.”
“Ah, the Spear Hero.”
The ranch owner looked at me and his expression softened.
“Even though it was to save Filolial-sama, I’m truly sorry for destroying the fence and letting the monsters escape.”

“No, we were so busy trying to protect ourselves that we forgot about the monsters escaping… Thanks to you, aside from the damage to part of the fence, the monsters didn’t suffer any major harm. There’s absolutely no need for an apology.”
“Were you able to rescue Lady Filolial-sama and the others who escaped?”
“Yes, pretty soon after we confirmed that the monsters that had come out in waves were gone…”
As expected of Filolial-sama—she’s truly intelligent. She must understand who her master is.
“That’s the best news of all.”
“Thank you very much.”
“Hahaha, Filolial-sama is a treasure of the world, after all—I merely did what was expected.”
Filolial-sama and the others came over near the fence and greeted us. It looked like Yuki-chan was raising her hand in a salute along with them.
“Hmm…”

When we returned from the ranch, my Father seemed to be groaning as he debated whether to load everything onto the wagon. It’s certainly a lot, after all. I imagine the kingdom took quite a bit, but there’s still plenty left.
“Um… if you’d like, I can lend you one of the village’s unused handcarts.”
“Huh? Is that okay? Well, that’d be a big help… I guess? Motoyasu, could you get more kids to pull the carriage?”
“Even a single angel could easily pull two vehicles—a carriage and a handcart.”
“Of course!”
“Yeah.”
“Kou can handle it easily, too.”
In fact, Filolial-sama and the others say it’s actually too light.
“Is that so? Well then, I’ll take you up on that.”
Father loads the chimera meat onto the handcart he received from the people of Riyute Village.
“Thank you so much for everything.”
“Is there anything else I can do?”

“No, thanks to the Shield Heroes and Spear Heroes and their party, the village buildings suffered no damage, and aside from disposing of the monster carcasses washed ashore by the waves, we’re able to go about our daily lives as usual.”
The people of Riyute Village, having learned of our arrival, have gathered around us.
“I see… I’m glad there was no damage. Also, thank you for all the kindness you showed us at the shops in the castle town.”

“No, no—we’re the ones who should be thanking you for protecting us. I’m glad to see that the Shield Hero isn’t the kind of person I’d heard about in rumors. In fact, we wouldn’t be able to forgive ourselves if we didn’t thank you.”
“…Well then, I’ll gladly accept your thanks. Take care.”
“Ah, Shield Hero!”
“What?”
“Is there anything else we can do to thank you? If you’re traveling by carriage or peddling goods, I think we could help you get a commercial passage permit issued.”
“……It’s okay, I already have one.”
“I see. My apologies for worrying unnecessarily. Well then, take care—Hero of the Shield and Spear Hero!”
The entire village of Riyute Village turned out to see us off.
“Given how things went, I guess we must have gotten the commercial pass in Riyute Village?”
“Do you think so?”

“Probably. I think I must’ve had a sudden idea about peddling somewhere along the way and had it issued here in this village. I imagine the village was suffering even more damage back then than it is now, so I probably spent some time helping with the reconstruction or something to earn a little pocket money… don’t you think?”

I see. Come to think of it, that was around this time. That’s when I met Filo-tan. Specifically, was it two or three days later? I still remember it clearly—my first encounter with Filo-tan. It all started with that meeting.

Back then, for some reason, the sight of my Father making Filo-tan pull a handcart really struck a funny bone, and I burst out laughing. Looking back now, I have a hard time understanding why I laughed. Hmm… it really is a mystery.

Probably, I laughed because of Father’s grumpy expression and the image I had of Filolial-sama. Just as I was thinking that horses or dragonriders were way cooler, I saw Father with Filo-tan… ...and seeing him trotting along side by side with Filo-tan—that’s the moment I burst out laughing.

But now, that moment is the absolute best. To punish me for laughing so foolishly and mocking others, Filo-tan delivered a powerful blow right to my groin. That electric shock that seemed to course through my entire body, and the sensation of time slowing down as I was blasted away like a rocket—it was an irreplaceable experience.
Ah…… Filo-tan. Where are you?
“Motoyasu’s daydreaming again, Naofumi.”
“Yeah. Just leave him be. He looks really happy.”
“I wonder what Spear-bro is thinking about. Something delicious, maybe?”
“Served with Keel-kun’s sauce?”
“How long are you going to keep dragging that joke out! Woof woof!”
“Boo……”
It seemed like the Lazy Pig was watching that exchange and letting out a deep sigh.
“Oh, right, Motoyasu-kun. Which one will you be the owner of—the Filolial or the dragon egg you bought today?”
“I don’t like dragons.”
“Hmm. But don’t you want to be the parent of that Filo kid, Motoyasu-kun?”
That’s true…
“I understand. Then I’ll handle the registration.”
“I suppose we could share it, but it’d probably be safer if Motoyasu-kun took care of it.”
“Hahaha, I think my Father right now is safer.”
I dripped my blood onto Filolial-sama’s egg and completed the registration. And so, that day, the carriage clattered along, making good time.
